obernants.operator: For U of declared input/output pairs, U\\graph(F) excludes success on any cyclic component, wrong endpoint/source error priority, nonminimal signed path sums, finite labels on unreachable vertices and vector-length mismatches. Negative edges are permitted on DAGs, so rejecting negativity alone is also excluded behavior.
